title: Claude Code's auto memory turned off in this repository, with its test, and MEMORY.md without the option (c) line

context.task: Small contract of ROADMAP D5 (ADR-010): this repository's .claude/settings.json turns Claude Code's auto memory off with autoMemoryEnabled false, a test pins it, the installer keeps leaving a target's auto memory alone, and the line of .claude/memory/MEMORY.md that says the option (c) denies that memory is corrected.

select.heading: ADR-010 — La memoria del agente, bajo código; la automática de Claude Code, apagada (2026-10-13, autor)

problem: Claude Code keeps an auto memory outside the repository (~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/), with no receipt and no versions, and tells the agent to write it; in Actuarii the agent's memory is .claude/memory/, governed and versioned by git (ADR-010). Today only a line of .claude/memory/MEMORY.md, loaded through CLAUDE.md, keeps the agent away from the auto memory, and that line is false: it says the option (c) denies it, but the option (c) went to the v0.2. The author decided on 2026-10-14 (ROADMAP D5, ADR-010) to turn the auto memory off in this whole project with autoMemoryEnabled false, in a small contract with its test and the correction of that line. Claude Code's documentation (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory and code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference, read on 2026-10-16) names the key autoMemoryEnabled: a boolean, accepted in any settings file, default true; with false Claude does not read from or write to the auto memory directory; to turn it off for one project it goes in that project's settings. ADR-010 also says that in the projects where the kit is installed the auto memory is not touched.
decisions: D1 .claude/settings.json gains one top-level key, "autoMemoryEnabled": false, on its own line right after "includeGitInstructions": false, with the same two-space indentation. Nothing else in the file changes: permissions, hooks, the other top-level keys and the sandbox stay byte for byte.

D2 tools/install.py does not change. It takes only permissions and hooks from the clone's settings (clone_kit_settings) and adds only includeGitInstructions and the sandbox to a target (merge_settings), so the new key does not reach a target, as ADR-010 requires. T3 pins that behaviour; if T3 cannot pass without a change to tools/install.py, stop and report.

D3 T1 goes in a new file, tests/security/test_auto_memory_setting.py, with a short module docstring that names ADR-010 and says why the key is pinned. It reads the committed .claude/settings.json as JSON and asserts that autoMemoryEnabled is the boolean False by identity (`is False`): an absent key, 0, "false" or null are red.

D4 T2 is the existing pin of the settings' top-level keys, test_registration_changes_nothing_else_in_settings in tests/security/test_contract_context_hook.py: its key set gains "autoMemoryEnabled", it asserts that the value is False, and its docstring adds this contract as the seventh deliberate change ("Claude Code's auto memory off, the memoria-automatica-apagada contract (ADR-010), is the seventh"). It is a change of the specification decided by the author, not a test changed to hide a failure (AGENTS 8.2). Nothing else in that file changes.

D5 T3 goes in tests/unit/test_installer.py with its existing fixtures and helpers (target, home, install, write_json, read_json): a fresh install writes a target .claude/settings.json without autoMemoryEnabled, and a target whose existing .claude/settings.json holds "autoMemoryEnabled": true still holds true after the install, which exits 0. One parametrized test or two tests: the implementer's choice, named in the report.

D6 .claude/memory/MEMORY.md (wording chosen by the author on 2026-10-16, with the limit): the bullet `* la memoria de Claude Code en `~/.claude/projects/…/memory/` no se usa en este proyecto: la opción (c) la deniega;` (one line) is replaced by exactly these three lines, the second and third indented by two spaces as the file's other wrapped bullets:
* la memoria automática de Claude Code (`~/.claude/projects/…/memory/`) está apagada en este proyecto:
  `autoMemoryEnabled: false` en `.claude/settings.json` (ADR-010). Es un ajuste, no una denegación: un
  `.claude/settings.local.json` o la variable `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY` pueden volver a encenderla;
Nothing else in the file changes. No test reads this file; the executing agent checks the text in the diff.

D7 A change to .claude/settings.json is not applied to the running session (tools/hooks/block_config_changes.py exits 2 on a project_settings change; the file still changes on disk). Nothing has to be restarted; the executing agent checks the effect in the next session.

D8 The session's validator requires a Rationale in every proposal (AGENTS.md 2.2). The schema of validate_proposal shown in the session may be an older copy without it: include it anyway, or the proposal comes back INVALID_JSON.

D9 Gates: red-first, each red test seen failing for its stated reason before the change that makes it pass; full-suite, `pytest tests/` exits 0 at the commit; verify-red-green, tools/audit/verify_red_green.py exits 0 on the report.

behaviours.statement: The committed .claude/settings.json holds the top-level key autoMemoryEnabled with the boolean value false.

The top-level keys of the committed .claude/settings.json are exactly permissions, hooks, enableAllProjectMcpServers, disableAllHooks, includeGitInstructions, autoMemoryEnabled and sandbox; everything else the existing pins hold stays as today.
The installer leaves a target's auto memory as the target has it: a fresh install adds no autoMemoryEnabled, and an existing value is kept.
.claude/memory/MEMORY.md no longer says that the option (c) denies Claude Code's auto memory; it says that autoMemoryEnabled false turns it off and what can turn it back on.

tests.must_catch: a committed .claude/settings.json without autoMemoryEnabled, or with any value other than the boolean false
tests.reason: at base .claude/settings.json has no autoMemoryEnabled key

tests.must_catch: a top-level key of .claude/settings.json added or dropped without a deliberate change, autoMemoryEnabled included
tests.reason: at base the key set of .claude/settings.json lacks autoMemoryEnabled

tests.must_catch: an installer that carries autoMemoryEnabled into a target, or changes the value a target already has
tests.reason: at base the installer takes only permissions and hooks from the clone's settings and keeps a target's other keys

commit_message: fix(memoria): la memoria automática de Claude Code, apagada aquí; MEMORY.md sin la opción (c)
